# Junction
URL: /docs/themes/junction
Description: Blueprint technical theme with a dark navigation spine and numbered sections
Related: /docs/themes, /docs/themes/creating-themes, /docs/customization/colors, /docs/customization/typography

Use `junction()` from the matching framework theme package and import `@farming-labs/theme/junction/css` globally. It supports Next.js, TanStack Start, Farm.js, SvelteKit, Astro, and Nuxt. Verify the blueprint grid, dark navigation spine, electric-blue structural rails, numbered sections, paper-like article panel, and near-black code surfaces. If colors load without structure, repair the shared CSS import. If the factory fails to resolve, use the matching framework package subpath.
